children: The Toro Company reported fiscal third-quarter net sales of $1.2258 billion and reported diluted EPS of $0.81 for the quarter ended July 31, 2026, with adjusted diluted EPS of $1.33. Net earnings were $77.0 million and adjusted net earnings per diluted share rose 7.3% year‑over‑year. The company raised its full‑year net sales and adjusted EPS guidance and returned $110 million to shareholders during the quarter.
Net sales: $1,225.8 million for Q3 fiscal 2026, up 8.4% year‑over‑year (Q3 fiscal 2025: $1,131.3 million).
Gross profit: $418.1 million for Q3; reported gross margin 34.1% (Q3 fiscal 2025 gross margin 33.7%).
Operating earnings: $115.2 million for Q3 fiscal 2026 (reported operating earnings margin 9.4%).
Net earnings: $77.0 million for Q3; reported diluted EPS $0.81.
Adjusted diluted EPS: $1.33 for Q3, up 7.3% versus prior-year adjusted EPS of $1.24; adjusted effective tax rate 22.4%.

Segment performance: Professional segment net sales were $1,012.6 million (up 8.8%) driven by higher volume, net price realization and the Tornado acquisition; Professional segment profit was $211.8 million (20.9% of segment sales).

Residential momentum: Residential net sales increased 8.6% to $209.3 million, led by higher volume of walk power mowers; Residential segment profit improved to $12.4 million (5.9% of segment sales) from $3.7 million a year earlier.
Operational improvements: Productivity initiatives and net price realization contributed to margin expansion and adjusted gross margin improvement to 35.0% from 34.4% a year earlier.

Working capital and cash flow: Company continued inventory reduction and improved working capital; net cash provided by operating activities was $476.2 million for the nine months ended July 31, 2026, with free cash flow of $425.1 million.

Capital allocation and M&A: Completed Tornado Infrastructure Equipment acquisition (Dec 8, 2025) contributed to Professional results; the company returned $110 million to shareholders in the quarter via dividends and share repurchases and has year‑to‑date returns of $471 million.
